searchText: Address space extension is going to break the ECRECOVER precompile to the point that we will need to introduce a ECRECOVER2 precompile. Do account abstraction people have any opinions about the future of ECRECOVER? I assume AA will break it again and it would be nice if we weren't forced to introduce a ECRECOVER3 precompile. The ASE problem is we need to introduce an epoch number argument so the precompile knows which address to recover to. I think the persona idea could make it so we don't actually need to break ECRECOVER? The problem is contracts need to be able to recover other people's signatures, regardless of whether their addresses are Legacy, Epoch 0, Epoch 1, etc... Yeah, you would just specify which persona you will recover to with the transaction. Ecrecover is provided a signature, and the transaction is bundled with a signed bit of data that says "when ecrecover recovers my public key, have it return this one of my addresses".
